summary: v1.1 backend testing: 20/20 new tests PASS + 15/15 v1 regression PASS = 35/35 total against public preview URL. Covered: (a) Team endpoints — owner-only guards on GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/team, sub-user login now returns parent_user_id + role=member + areas=['network'], full invite→login→update areas→delete cycle including sub-user login rejection post-delete. (b) Area enforcement — sub-user (network only) receives 403 with Italian message 'Area energy non consentita per questo utente' on POST /contacts, /appointments, /callbacks in energy area. (c) Tenant model — sub-created docs have created_by=sub_id, user_id=owner_id; sub GET /contacts|/appointments|/callbacks returns ONLY docs with created_by==sub_id; owner GET sees ALL tenant docs; sub GET /contacts/{owner_contact_id} returns 404 (scoped-out). (d) Settings — sub PUT /settings returns 403, sub GET /settings returns the same tenant settings doc as owner (same user_id). (e) Reports scoping — sub totals ≤ owner totals for every area/metric over the year period. (f) v1 regression — /auth/me + logout, contacts/notes/files, reports for day/week/month/year, all passed unchanged. No backend issues found. Sub-user account was pre-existing per test_credentials.md; test suite auto-creates and cleans up TEST_-prefixed temp members/contacts/appointments/callbacks.
